answer: A milestone bond blocks mass fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits, files one onyx-sealed checkpoint reading per epoch. A prism ledger splits readings by checkpoint, time, key; copies stand out. A copy is an echo of an earlier filing, retimestamped; a replaying auditor burns the bond. Filing 35, the k-th fake 35+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,531,500 for a 40,000 pool. A rented ring fails, one echo betrays every copy; an honest agent pays 35 once.
